films.title: Spellbound
films.overview: A magician makes an assistant out of a strange girl with the ability to see ghosts, and the two achieve success with their shows, through thick and thin. However, another kind of magic might be brewing behind the scenes of their act... love!

films.title: Monster
films.overview: Bok-Soon runs a street stall, cares for her younger sister, and is feared by many because of her quick temper. When Tae-Soo murders her sister, rage consumes her completely as she stalks the killer.

films.title: Decibel
films.overview: A former Naval officer with a dark past must face off against an insurgent with a sound sensitive bomb.
